series: AXIS Camera Station S12 Recording Server Series

video.decoding_capability: Live view: 1 stream x 4K at 30 fps; 4 split x 1080p at 30 fps; 9 split x 720p at 30 fps; 16, 25 and 36 split x 360p at 15 fps

storage.built_in: 8 TB (1x 8 TB) cold-swappable Enterprise Class SATA HDD, 7200 rpm, 1 free slot; 256 GB SSD operating system drive

features: 16 AXIS Camera Station Pro Core Device NVR licenses and 10 AXIS Audio Manager Pro licenses included
Qualified for 64 doors and 32 video channels; 256 Mbit/s corresponds to 4 MP, 30 fps per channel in a retail scenario
Can be scaled with more devices when using AXIS S30 Recorder Series
Qualified for 200 simultaneous audio streams using AXIS Audio Manager Pro
Qualified for up to 1,000 doors with access control only
Preloaded with AXIS Camera Station Pro
FIPS 140-2 level 2 certified Trusted Platform Module (TPM 2.0); support for encrypted operating system and recording drives
notes: Datasheet gives power consumption of 80 W typical and 110 W maximum.
